Signed release of Luma 1.0.0 (`com.metaphasic.luma`, versionCode 1, targetSdk 36).

- `luma-1.0.0-release.aab` is the file to upload in Google Play Console.
- `luma-1.0.0-release.apk` is the same build for installing on a phone.

On GitHub, open the file and use Download raw file. The upload keystore is not in this folder.
